title: Sparkly Christmas tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tree' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#2fbf5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1a7a3a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tree2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3ad96e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#22a050'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='trunk' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#c0763a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8a4a1e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- trunk -->
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='12' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#trunk)'/>

  <!-- tree layers -->
  <polygon points='50,10 27,42 73,42' fill='url(#tree2)'/>
  <polygon points='50,28 20,62 80,62' fill='url(#tree)'/>
  <polygon points='50,48 12,84 88,84' fill='url(#tree2)'/>

  <!-- lighter edges for readability -->
  <polyline points='27,42 50,10 73,42' fill='none' stroke='#7ef0a2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polyline points='20,62 50,28 80,62' fill='none' stroke='#7ef0a2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polyline points='12,84 50,48 88,84' fill='none' stroke='#7ef0a2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- star on top -->
  <polygon points='50,2 53,9 61,9 55,14 57,21 50,17 43,21 45,14 39,9 47,9' fill='#ffd24a' stroke='#fff2b0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- ornaments -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='3.4' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='3.4' fill='#4fc3ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='3.4' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='3.6' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='3.6' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='3.6' fill='#4fc3ff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='78' r='3' fill='#b98cff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='79' r='3' fill='#ff9a3c'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff2b0'>
    <polygon points='16,20 18,25 23,27 18,29 16,34 14,29 9,27 14,25'/>
    <polygon points='85,16 86.5,20 90.5,21.5 86.5,23 85,27 83.5,23 79.5,21.5 83.5,20'/>
    <polygon points='88,50 89.5,54 93.5,55.5 89.5,57 88,61 86.5,57 82.5,55.5 86.5,54'/>
    <polygon points='10,52 11.5,56 15.5,57.5 11.5,59 10,63 8.5,59 4.5,57.5 8.5,56'/>
    <polygon points='78,34 79.5,38 83.5,39.5 79.5,41 78,45 76.5,41 72.5,39.5 76.5,38'/>
    <polygon points='22,62 23.5,66 27.5,67.5 23.5,69 22,73 20.5,69 16.5,67.5 20.5,66'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#4fc3ff'>
    <circle cx='14' cy='38' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='34' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='14' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='86' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='88' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='74' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
